text.text_excerpt: This is where I go for my sushi fix. I popped in randomly a couple months ago and I've had a slight craving for it up until about a week ago when the crave became full-blown unbearable. Both times I've walked in, I was met with the smiles of the wait staff and some of the better sushi in the city, IMO. Their specialty rolls are the tits! My first visit's order escapes me but last night I dropped in and had some hot sake (a must whenever there's sushi) the Sexy roll and the Sara roll. Both were exquisite but I think I could have easily eaten three helpings of that Sara roll alone. The owner (I'm assuming) of the place is a super sweet woman with the warmest disposition that should be proud...

I was having a sushi craving that demanded satisfaction, so I headed over to the newest sushi place on Poydras. I popped in during a busy lunch hour and I was seated at the sushi bar- right in the middle of the excitement! The sushi chefs greeted me and I looked over the menu and tried to decide exactly what I wanted. After ordering a few rolls, I was given a complimentary clear soup that made for a delightful start to the meal. Because I went during the busiest time of the day, the food took a little while but I knew that it would be worth the wait. Great new sushi place uptown! While there are many sushi places in this city, I am always happy to add another restaurant to my sushi rotation. Osaka Kohai is delicious, adorable, and convenient; an all around win! My friend and I went to Osaka Kohai at 6:30 on a Friday night. The first thing I noticed is how adorable the restaurant is. It is located inside a shotgun house and feels very homey while still looking trendy. We sat at the sushi bar, which I love doing when I go out with only 1 other person.
